Hi, I'm Pinki Kumari — a Software Development Engineer at Texas Instruments building enterprise manufacturing and quality platforms across backend and frontend services. I earned an M.Tech. in Computer Science from IIT Gandhinagar (2022–2024) and work primarily with Java, Spring Boot, React, and SQL alongside CI/CD, production support, and infrastructure operations.

I previously collaborated with [Prof. Anirban Dasgupta](https://sites.google.com/site/anirbandasgupta) on Automatic Speech Recognition using Neural Tangent Kernels and spent a summer at [ThirdAI Corp.](https://www.thirdai.com/) refining CPU-based training and evaluation pipelines for LLMs.
